_readme: Hand-checked evaluation set (v2). For answerable questions the question and a verbatim evidence_snippet were chosen by reading source text; relevant_document_ids lists every document in documents_merged.jsonl whose whitespace-normalised text contains that snippet (re-verified by `python -m src.rag.evaluate --check-labels`). Unanswerable questions list absent_terms that must match zero documents; three pension-sounding ones have a `reason` and were judged by hand instead. Labels were authored by the assistant and have NOT been independently reviewed by a human; review before relying on the numbers.
